basic_details.job_title: HSACS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 3 Care Coordinator, Counsellor Posts
basic_details.short_information: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

qualification.education_qualification: Care Coordinator (PLHIV) (ART): Person Living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV) with 12th Pass. Counsellor (ICTC): Graduate in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing with 3 years of experience in counseling / educating under National Health Programme, OR Post-graduate in these subjects; PLHIV graduates need 1 year of such experience.

vacancy_details.details: Qualification required: Essential Qualification: Person Living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV) with 12th Pass. Essential Experience: Working knowledge of English and Local language. Experience required: Essential Experience: Working knowledge of English and Local language. Desirable: Working knowledge of Computer, usage of Internet and electronic mail. Age limit: Maximum 42 years. Pay: Rs. 18,000. Qualification required: Graduate degree holder in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing with 3 years of experience in counseling / educating under National Health Programme; OR Post-graduate in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing; If candidate is a person living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV): Graduate degree holder in Psychol

salary_details.pay_scale: Consolidated honorarium of Rs. 18,000 per month (Care Coordinator) and Rs. 21,000 per month (Counsellor); no other allowance

how_to_apply: Download the application form from www.nhmharyana.gov.in.
Fill the form completely and mention the total number of pages attached.
Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates, testimonials, experience certificate, residence and caste proof, and any three listed address documents.
Send the form (offline only) to Data Manager at ART Center, Opposite NHM office, O/o Civil Surgeon, Faridabad.
The application must reach by 04:00 PM on 20.11.2026, on working days (Monday to Friday).
important_instructions: Applications received after 4:00 PM on 20.11.2026 will not be entertained One application will be accepted for one post only Incomplete applications will be rejected No addendum documents accepted after the last date Check www.nhmharyana.gov.in for updates or corrigendum

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply for HSACS Recruitment 2026?
content_sections.text: Age relaxation, Counsellor (ICTC): SC / BC-A Age relaxation admissible as per Haryana Govt. Policy (Haryana Government notification No. 22/06/2021-1 GS-III Chandigarh dated 25th March 2022). Other conditions: Care Coordinator must be a Person Living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV) Care Coordinator: working knowledge of English and local language Experience counts only after completion of Degree/Diploma Preference to employees working or who worked in State Govt/Semi Govt/UT/Govt Board/Corporation/NHM Desirable: Care Coordinator: working knowledge of computer, usage of Internet and electronic mail

Age limit: Maximum 42 years. Pay: Rs. 18,000. Qualification required: Graduate degree holder in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing with 3 years of experience in counseling / educating under National Health Programme; OR Post-graduate in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing; If candidate is a person living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV): Graduate degree holder in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing with 1 year of experience in counseling / educating under National Health Programmes. content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Purely contractual for the period up to 31/03/2027 Renewable year-to-year on performance assessment as per NACO guidelines, subject to approval Not a regular Government job All posts are non-transferable

content_sections.heading: How Will HSACS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: No written test or interview Document verification on 30-11-2026 No written test or interview will be conducted Original documents verified on 30-11-2026: Care Coordinator at 10:00 AM, Counsellor at 01:00 PM

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies of certificates/testimonials Experience certificate stating date of appointment and remuneration, with salary slips/bank statements Proof of residence and caste certificates issued by appropriate authorities Any three of: Passport, Voter ID Card, Ration card with address, Caste and Domicile certificate, Parivar Pehchan Patra, Electricity bill (not older than 3 months)

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for HSACS Recruitment 2026 Offline
content_sections.text: Download the application form from www.nhmharyana.gov.in. Fill the form completely and mention the total number of pages attached. Attach self-attested photocopies of certificates, testimonials, experience certificate, residence and caste proof, and any three listed address documents. Send the form (offline only) to Data Manager at ART Center, Opposite NHM office, O/o Civil Surgeon, Faridabad. The application must reach by 04:00 PM on 20.11.2026, on working days (Monday to Friday).

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Applications received after 4:00 PM on 20.11.2026 will not be entertained One application will be accepted for one post only Incomplete applications will be rejected No addendum documents accepted after the last date Check www.nhmharyana.gov.in for updates or corrigendum

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HSACS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the organisation by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in HSACS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: 1 Care Coordinator (PLHIV) (ART), 2 Counsellor (ICTC).

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for HSACS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Fill in the application form (Website www.nhmharyana.gov.in) and send it to Data Manager, ART Center, Opposite NHM office, O/o Civil Surgeon, Faridabad, by offline (post or in person), to reach by 20 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 42 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 18,000 for Care Coordinator (PLHIV) (ART), Rs. 21,000 for Counsellor (ICTC).

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Care Coordinator (PLHIV) (ART): Person Living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV) with 12th Pass. Counsellor (ICTC): Graduate in Psychology / Social Work / Sociology / Anthropology / Human Development / Nursing with 3 years of experience in counseling / educating under National Health Programme, OR Post-graduate in these subjects; PLHIV graduates need 1 year of such experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Care Coordinator must be a Person Living with HIV/AIDS (PLHIV). Care Coordinator: working knowledge of English and local language. Experience counts only after completion of Degree/Diploma. Preference to employees working or who worked in State Govt/Semi Govt/UT/Govt Board/Corporation/NHM.

faq.question: Q8. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates whose services were terminated from any Govt./Semi Govt./Corporate/Board/NHM. Persons against whom any pending criminal case/FIR is lodged.

faq.question: Q9. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No written test or interview. Document verification on 30-11-2026. No written test or interview will be conducted. Original documents verified on 30-11-2026: Care Coordinator at 10:00 AM, Counsellor at 01:00 PM.

faq.question: Q10. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Purely contractual for the period up to 31/03/2027. Renewable year-to-year on performance assessment as per NACO guidelines, subject to approval. Not a regular Government job.
